source_caption:
Steve Carell recorded most of Gru’s lines for Despicable Me while improvising jokes and reactions in the studio. The filmmakers loved his spontaneous delivery so much that many of those improvised moments ended up in the final film.

Despicable Me (2010), directed by Pierre Coffin & Chris Renaud, starring Steve Carell, Jason Segel, Russell Brand. A hilarious and surprisingly heartfelt animated adventure where a supervillain’s plan is turned upside down after adopting three girls who unexpectedly transform his life.

source_details.title: Despicable Me
source_details.synopsis: Despicable Me is a 2010 American animated comedy film directed by Chris Renaud and Pierre Coffin and written by Cinco Paul and Ken Daurio. The first feature film produced by Illumination Entertainment, it features the voices of Steve Carell, Jason Segel, Russell Brand, Kristen Wiig, Miranda Cosgrove, Will Arnett, and Julie Andrews. The story follows Gru, a longtime supervillain who adopts three orphan girls to use as pawns in a sinister scheme, but reluctantly develops an emotional attachment to them.
